text:
Liam: Hey folks — thinking of doing a retro/emulation LAN this Friday after hours. I can bring a CRT, 2 SNES controllers, and a Pi set up with RetroArch. Also found a handful of spare Steam keys for small co-op indies. Anyone interested? :joystick: :tv:

Nina: heck yes. what time were you thinking? :raised_hands:

Cheng: count me in if we can squeeze in some Smash or Cuphead. Also I can bring a second monitor.

Maya: I can make snacks. cinnamon pretzels? :drooling_face:

Randall:Interested but travel + baby bedtime complicates. Could join remotely for a few rounds?

Liam: plan was around 7pm — casual drop-in. Bring controllers if you have them. Remote folks welcome, we'll spin up a Steam Remote Play lobby for indie co-op.

Nina: sweet. my vote for games:
```
- Super Smash Bros. (emulated)
- Cuphead
- Lovers in a Dangerous Spacetime
- Overcooked 2
- Crawl (local co-op)
```

Cheng: +1 Overcooked and Smash. If we do Remote Play, maybe avoid input-heavy fighting in remote matches.

Maya: snacks and slow ambient music playlist incoming. also can bring an extra ethernet cable for stable LAN.

Randall: I can hop in for Overcooked remotely for a round or two. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Note: reserving conf-room B (6:30–10:30pm) for private event. Please confirm room setup: "TV + HDMI" or "Projector".

Liam: ops-bot thanks! TV + HDMI please. Anyone have a switch dock?

Nina: I have a Switch dock and an extra Joy-Con pair.

Cheng: I'll bring adapters for USB controllers and a PS4 pad.

Maya: will label snacks "LAN fuel" so they don't disappear before 7pm. :sweat_smile:

Liam: OK final quick poll — who can definitely make it in person? React with :thumbsup: in your head and post here if yes. (Randall remote ok)

Nina: :thumbsup: in real life.

Cheng: :thumbsup:

Maya: :thumbsup:

Randall: Remote :wave:

Liam: sweet. I'll paste the Steam Remote Play link and a short schedule tomorrow. Thanks y'all — low-key, no-pressure, good vibes. :partyparrot:
